name: Hitotsu Yane no Shita★
source:
The protagonist is in her second year of high school.

Her mother passed away when she was little, so she's living alone with her father.
One day, he brings home three guys, claiming they're the sons of a friend.
Seems they'll be living here for a while.
That's how the story of the roof they share begins...

[Translated from [url=https://bshadow.gozaru.jp/game/hitotu/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角是高中二年级学生。

她的母亲在她很小的时候就去世了，所以她和父亲一起生活。
有一天，他带了三个人回家，声称他们是朋友的儿子。
看来他们要在这里住一段时间了。
他们共享屋顶的故事就这样开始了……

[翻译自[url=https://bshadow.gozaru.jp/game/hitotu/index.html]官网[/url]]
